items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Was Don Redman there?' and confirms 'Yes, Don Redman' in the context of listing band members, but the interviewee does not speak or confirm a personal relationship.

ctx.x: Oh brother! We had Sandy Williams, (Y.) Williams, (Y) Jay C. Higginbotham, (Y.) Bobby Stark, (Y.) Coleman Hawkins - everybody in the band was (Y.)
Yes, Don Redman. And Rex Stewart was with us for a while and Bob Stark and Billie Holiday's father, Clarence Holiday.
